fragments.source: The source review found three distinct compositions with stepped silhouettes, fine pixel clusters and painterly light: floral/bird-painted craft objects around an open courtyard gate; warm CRT and arcade silhouettes against a rainy blue window; and a fantasy canal/exchange city with cargo boats and lit workshops. Tiny decorative tape-spine markings in the arcade are not readable game instructions or recognized branding. The city is a fictional coordination metaphor, not a depiction of Coupa software or actual savings. Dense courtyard foliage, rug texture and bright canal reflections still require actual line/actor/objective contrast checks in the game. This review does not certify historical authenticity, a uniform hand-authored pixel grid, compact-board readability or animation inside the static paintings.
